page.overview:
What is The Gatewatch?

The Gatewatch is a group of planeswalkers initially allied together to fight the Eldrazi on Zendikar. Named for their defense of Sea Gate. Their commitment is to protect the people of the Multiverse from threats that no one else can handle. From Battle for Zendikar up until War of the Spark, the Gatewatch became the center of Magic's storyline.

The group was founded by Gideon Jura, Jace Beleren, Chandra Nalaar, and Nissa Revane.

{| class="wikitable sortable" ! Name !! Status !! Joined !! Oath !! Left !! Note

Additionally, Lavinia, Jace's assistant on Ravnica, is in charge of maintaining the Gatewatch's headquarters on that plane and knows that they are planeswalkers.

Also known as: Gatewatch coalition.
